newsitem.title: USA: Family Steak recommends rejecting bid.
newsitem.headline: Family Steak recommends rejecting bid.

text.p: Family Steak Houses of Florida Inc said on Wednesday that its board is recommending that shareholders reject a tender offer by Bisco Industries.
It said Bisco Industries' bid to acquire up to 2.6 million shares of stock for $0.90 a share is "inadequate" and not in the best interests of shareholders.
The company also plans to accelerate the record date for a rights plan to March 19, 1997, Family Steak said. The previous record date was not immediately available.

Family Steak said the rights plan, which goes into effect when a person or group becomes owners or makes a tender offer for more than 15 percent of the company's common stock, is designed to deter coercive and unfair takeover tactics.
